name: How do I choose the right contractor for a multigenerational home project?
description: Choose a contractor with experience in ADUs, proper licensing, good references, clear bids, and strong communication, ensuring they understand local codes.

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for a multigenerational home project?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor, look for experience with ADUs or similar residential additions, proper licensing and insurance, and positive client references. Request detailed bids that clearly outline costs, timelines, and scope of work. It's important to choose a contractor who communicates effectively, understands your vision for multigenerational living, and is familiar with local building codes in your area. Review their portfolio and ensure they offer transparent contracts.
